topic: Large Language Models and the Transformer Architecture
target_audience: University students with a basic background in computer science or programming

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Word Embeddings
lecture_lines: Words convert into high-dimensional numerical vectors.
Similar words cluster closely in semantic space.
animations: Show vector representation of a simple word. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Fade in word cluster visualization for context. (Color: #808080)
Highlight similarity distance between related words. (Color: #FF0000)

sections.title: The Core Innovation: Self-Attention Mechanism
lecture_lines: Self-attention calculates relevance scores between words.
Context depends on other sentence words.
animations: Show attention weights as glowing paths. (Color: #FFFF00)

sections.title: The Transformer Architecture: Encoder and Decoder
lecture_lines: Encoders process and understand input text.

sections.title: Scaling to Large Language Models (LLMs)
lecture_lines: LLMs train on massive data corpora.
Performance scales with parameters and data.
animations: Represent model parameters as expanding grid. (Color: #FFFFFF)

sections.title: Practical Application: Next-Token Prediction
lecture_lines: Models predict the next likely token.
They function as advanced probability engines.
animations: Select next token based on distribution. (Color: #00FF00)
